mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_run WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE run_attempt SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}) WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND run_id = #{id} AND attempt_no = #{currentAttemptNo}

UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'queued', current_attempt_no = current_attempt_no + 1, output_message_id = #{output}, next_attempt_at = #{available}, queued_at = #{available}, execution_phase = 'between_steps', error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, active_millis = active_millis + IF(active_segment_started_at IS NULL, 0, GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, active_segment_started_at, #{now}) DIV 1000)), active_segment_started_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, has_step_errors = TRUE WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND current_attempt_no = #{currentAttemptNo} AND current_attempt_no < max_attempts AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{code}, error_message = #{message}, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, next_attempt_at = NULL, active_millis = active_millis + IF(active_segment_started_at IS NULL, 0, GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, active_segment_started_at, #{now}) DIV 1000)), active_segment_started_at = NULL, has_step_errors = EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_step s WHERE s.enterprise_id = agent_run.enterprise_id AND s.run_id = agent_run.id AND s.status = 'failed') WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval','cancelling')
